doubts.q: The Settings modal's left nav differs between rows. Connectors row: General / Data and memory / Connectors / Skills. Skills and Get App rows: the same plus Get App & Extensions. Memory rows: General / Memory / Models / Skills / Get App & Extensions. The two loose 'Dialog - Settings' frames: General / Memory / Connectors / Skills / Get App & Extension. Which list does the prototype use everywhere?
doubts.proposedDefault: One nav on every Settings screen: General, Memory, Connectors, Skills, Get App & Extensions (the loose consolidated dialog). Memory opens the Memory journeys. Models is dropped because no frame designs it.

doubts.q: No frame designs the General tab, or Models, which only appears in the Memory rows. What should Settings show when General is clicked, and which tab opens first?
doubts.proposedDefault: Settings opens on the tab the journey starts from. General shows a 'not designed yet' stub with the modal chrome, and Models is not shown.

doubts.q: Two rows are both labelled 'Edit using AI input box'. One row (10101/10204 ids) edits from inside one memory's detail view and ends with 'Updated Memory / Undo'. The other (10190/11674 ids, newer) edits from the Memory list input and adds the 'No changes were made' branch. Are these two entry points, or is the newer row a replacement?
doubts.proposedDefault: Two entry points, both kept: memory-individual (in-detail edit) and memory-edit-ai-list (list-level edit, including the no-op branch).

doubts.q: The second Memory row has no title label. It starts with the 'Memory' COMPONENT master 10112:406770 and runs hover, open detail, edit with AI, rename, add details. Is the component master a real step, and is this one journey?
doubts.proposedDefault: One journey, 'Individual memory', with the component master as step 1 (the populated list).

doubts.q: Several loose frames on this page seem to belong to other pages' journeys: Share Project (10101:548721), 'Who can view this?' (10136:603182), Add Text Content (10136:602967, 10101:548663), a Templates modal (9890:402740/402769/402778), 'Choose your agents' (9893:422543) and a time picker (10101:548486). Should they be mapped here?
doubts.proposedDefault: Ignore them here (they are listed under loose). Take them from their home pages; fall back to these frames only if a home page lacks them.
